title: Analogimations
intro: Interactive animations. Pick one to open it. Each one works full screen on an iPad and sideways on a phone.

animations.title: Pressure Vessel Mixer
animations.blurb: Three sources push colored particles into a vessel at different pressures. See which ones get in, how they mix, and what leaves through the outlet.

animations.title: Aquifer Wells
animations.blurb: Four wells, shallow and deep, with small and large pumps, draw from one aquifer. Raise or lower the water table and see which wells keep flowing and which run dry.
